entities.name: Sirat al-Zahir Baibars
entities.label: Text
entities.summary: Sīrat al-Ẓāhir Baybars, also known as al-Sīrah Ẓāhirīyah, is a long Egyptian folkloric epic poem that narrates the life and heroic achievements of the Mamluk Sultan al-Zahir Baibars al-Bunduqdari.
